_editionsNote: The active edition is the first one whose `until` date has not passed (in its own time zone, from the system clock). It gets its full kb/<id>/ files; the others contribute only kb/<id>/_summary.md. kb/common/ is always included. Override with --edition <id>. Switching needs an `update` run: the agent does not switch by itself.
